prompt:
A horizontal strip of pixel art showing the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised wall/ledge, exactly as such faces look in a top-down JRPG map (we look straight at the face; it is the drop between an upper level and the floor). It fills the whole image edge to edge: the top 6% is the lit rim/lip of the upper surface, the face below gets gradually darker toward the bottom, and the bottom 8% is a dark contact band where it meets the floor. No floor, no sky, no objects in front. SEAMLESS horizontally (left edge continues into the right edge). The strip is about 256 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels). Material: a mine tunnel wall of dark rock braced with wooden support beams and a horizontal timber, ore veins
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
revised_prompt: Generate one horizontal, edge-to-edge, tileable pixel-art texture strip, aspect ratio 2:1. It depicts ONLY the straight-on vertical FRONT FACE of a raised mine-tunnel wall/ledge in a top-down JRPG map: not a perspective view, not a room, not a cross section. Target underlying art grid about 256 x 128 square pixels, uniformly enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor edges; every pixel same square size. Top 6% a continuous narrow lit rock rim/lip of the upper surface. Below it the vertical wall face, dark rocky stone gradually deepening in value toward bottom; bottom 8% continuous very dark contact band. Dark rock with embedded modest earthy ore veins, periodic sturdy vertical wooden support beams and a horizontal timber across the rock face. Arrange beams and rock shapes so horizontal tiling is seamless: left and right edges have matching continuation, no visible tile seam. The art fills all canvas, with no floor, sky, characters or foreground objects. Premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art, hand-placed coherent clusters of 3–10 pixels, sharp aligned uniform square pixels and clean readable rock/wood shapes; no antialiasing, blur, gradients made of smooth pixels, photographic texture, random noise, or checkerboard dithering. Rich earthy palette with 4–6 discrete shades per material, warm-yellow highlights and slightly purple/red saturated shadows. Neutral soft even overcast upper-left illumination, clean base colors, no cast shadows, nighttime darkness, light sources, glow, light pools, or vignette. An environment texture sheet, not an illustration framed by a background.
